meta.title: Sell your LEGO® in Amsterdam | Stackback buys your LEGO
meta.description: Send a few photos on WhatsApp and get a fair, no-obligation offer for your LEGO® within 24 hours. Free pickup in Amsterdam, paid on the spot.
meta.ogTitle: Old LEGO® in the attic? Stackback buys it.

whatsapp.message: Hi Stackback! I have some LEGO I'd like to sell. Here are a few photos.

hero.intro: Send us a few photos on WhatsApp. Within 24 hours you get a fair offer, with no obligation. If you say yes, we pick it up for free and pay you on the spot.

steps.title: How it works
steps.intro: No sorting, building or counting needed. We do the work.

items.title: Send photos
items.text: Message us a few photos from your phone. One overview shot is enough to get started.

items.title: Get your offer
items.text: Within 24 hours we send an offer, with an explanation of how we got there. You're not committed to anything.

items.title: We pick it up
items.text: If you say yes, we agree on a time. We take a quick look at your place and pay you straight away.

buy.title: What we buy
buy.intro: Mostly sets and minifigures. Built, taken apart or still in the box, it doesn't matter.

items.title: Complete sets
items.text: With or without the box, built or in pieces. Instruction booklets and the original box raise your offer.

items.title: Nearly complete sets
items.text: A few pieces missing? No problem. We work out what it costs to complete the set and only deduct that.

items.title: Minifigures
items.text: We value every figure separately. Some are worth more on their own than you'd expect, such as many Star Wars, Harry Potter and older figures.

items.title: Boxes and tubs of loose LEGO
items.text: Interesting when there are minifigures or recognisable sets mixed in. Loose bricks only, we sometimes buy. Send a photo and we'll tell you honestly.

items.title: New, sealed sets
items.text: Still in the sealed box? We're happy to buy those, also when it's several sets.

buy.not: Knock-off brands (such as Lepin, King or other copies) and LEGO that is broken, melted or badly discoloured. Not sure? Send a photo, we're always happy to take a look.

pricing.title: How we work out your offer
pricing.intro: No guessing from one photo of a tub. For every set and every minifigure, we look up what it currently sells for second-hand in the Netherlands and Europe. Then we look at four things:

factors.title: Completeness
factors.text: Are pieces or minifigures missing, and what does it cost to complete them?

factors.title: Box and booklets
factors.text: A set with its box and booklets is clearly worth more than the same set without.

factors.title: Condition
factors.text: Scratches, discolouration, missing stickers or a damaged box all count.

factors.title: Our work and risk
factors.text: We check everything, clean it, complete sets and resell them. That takes time, and sometimes a set turns out not to be complete after all.

pricing.promise: Every offer comes with an explanation. Want to know exactly how we got to a number? Just ask and we'll show you.
pricing.boostTitle: How to make your LEGO worth more
boost: Keep the instruction booklets and boxes, even if they're a bit worn.
Keep minifigures with their set, if you know which goes where.
Please don't clean it yourself with hot water or cleaning products. We'll do that.

photos.title: Which photos help most?
photos.intro: The better we can see what you have, the sharper our offer. This helps:
items: One overview photo of everything together.
The minifigures side by side, photographed from the front.
Boxes and instruction booklets, if you have them.
Set numbers, if you know them. They're on the box and the booklet.
For a tub of loose LEGO: how full it is, or its weight. A bathroom scale is fine.
photos.note: Don't know something or short on time? Just send what you have, we'll ask if we need more.

about.title: About Stackback
text: Stackback was founded by two LEGO fans from Amsterdam. We buy LEGO that's gathering dust at home, check it, complete the sets and pass them on to new builders.
You get your space back, and your LEGO gets played with again instead of sitting in a box.

items.q: How much is my LEGO worth?
items.a: It varies a lot. A tub of loose bricks usually isn't worth that much, while a complete set or a sought-after minifigure can be worth surprisingly more. That's why we look at every set and every figure. Send photos and you'll know within 24 hours.

items.q: Do I need to sort or build everything first?
items.a: No. Built, taken apart or mixed in a tub is all fine. Sorting and checking is our job.
That's completely normal. We work out what it costs to complete the set and factor that into our offer.

items.q: Am I committed to the offer?
items.a: No, our offer comes with no obligation and is valid for seven days. On our side, the offer stands as long as the LEGO matches the photos. If we see big differences at pickup, such as missing minifigures, we'll tell you honestly and you can still say no.

items.q: Why don't I get the full price I see online?
items.a: Online prices are what someone eventually gets after a lot of work: checking everything, taking photos, writing listings, talking to buyers and shipping. We take over that work and the risk, and pay you straight away. If you want the maximum and have the time, you can also sell it online yourself.

items.q: What do you do with my LEGO?
items.a: We check and clean everything, complete sets where needed and sell them on to other builders and collectors.

items.q: Do you pick up outside Amsterdam?
items.a: For now we pick up for free in Amsterdam. Live nearby? Message us anyway, for a nice collection we're happy to come by.
Straight away at pickup: cash, by Tikkie or by bank transfer. Your choice.

items.q: Do you buy other toys or other building bricks?
items.a: No, only genuine LEGO. We don't buy knock-off brands.

items.q: What happens to my photos and details?
items.a: We only use your photos and phone number for your offer and the pickup, and never share them. If there's no deal, we delete the conversation within 3 months. More in our privacy statement.

cta.title: Ready to clear some space?
cta.text: Send a few photos. Within 24 hours you'll know what your LEGO is worth.

footer.tagline: We buy second-hand LEGO® in Amsterdam.
footer.trademark: LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group. Stackback is an independent business and is not affiliated with or sponsored by the LEGO Group.
footer.privacy: This website uses no cookies. We count visits anonymously.

p: Stackback buys second-hand LEGO® from private individuals in and around Amsterdam. For privacy questions, message or call us on {phone}.

list: Your phone number and the name you use on WhatsApp.
The photos and information you send us about your LEGO.
Your address and the agreed time, if we come to pick up your LEGO.
Your name and account number, if you choose payment by bank transfer or Tikkie.

p: Only to make you an offer, arrange the pickup, pay you and keep our records. We don't send you advertising and don't use your data for anything else.
We use your data because it's needed to make an offer and complete the sale (performance of a contract). For completed purchases, there is also a legal obligation to keep records.

list: No deal? We delete the conversation and photos within 3 months.
A deal? We only keep what our records require (date, amount and payment details) for as long as the law requires, usually 7 years. We delete the rest of the conversation within 3 months.

p: We never sell or share your data. We do use services that are needed for this: WhatsApp (Meta) for our conversations and the bank or Tikkie for payments. They process your data under their own privacy policies.

This website uses no cookies. We count visits anonymously with GoatCounter: which page was viewed, which link or QR code someone came from, and the type of device. We don't store IP addresses and can't identify anyone.

You can always ask what data we have about you, and ask us to correct or delete it. Message or call us and we'll sort it out. If you disagree with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
